title: Save the Planet
altText: Powerful environmental street art mural by Mr Blob titled Save the Planet, featuring a giant surreal marine creature, a sea turtle, and a polar bear trapped on a melting globe split in half.
description: Painted in Milan in 2020, Save the Planet splits the globe in two: on one side a melting iceberg with a stranded polar bear, on the other a rising cityscape crowned by a construction crane, the halves held together only by a thin planetary ring. Between them floats a red-and-blue patterned marine creature escorted by sea turtles and birds, turning the wall into a direct environmental appeal.
